messages:
marie: Quick heads-up — aiming to cut v2.7.0 tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Need a final green sweep and flaky triage today. Please report any failing suites here. Tagging @ci-oncall for infra checks.
ajay: On it — running a full build matrix now, will post failures. ETA ~20m.
build-bot: CI run started: pipeline #4821 on branch release/v2.7.0 — https://ci.redwood/4821
lina: One flaky in integration/auth that repros locally for me intermittently. Logs show timeout in login flow.
tomas: I can take auth flake. @lina can you paste the failing test log and the exact command you used?
lina: Command: `pytest tests/integration/test_auth.py::test_login_flow -k 'oauth' -q` Log excerpt: ```AssertionError: expected 200 but got 503 at auth_client.py:42```
tomas: Thanks. I'll add a retry and check upstream service mocks. If fix is trivial, push to release/v2.7.0-hotfix and hold for a quick smoke.
ajay: CI hit another: e2e/browser on mac-latest random timeout. Build shows `selenium.TimeoutException`.
ci-oncall: Seeing infra GKE node reboots in us-west1 around 08:12 UTC — may explain browser flakes. I've requested autoscaler bump.
emily: Quick changelog nudge: we need one-liners from eng-ml and eng-runtime for breaking changes. Please drop PRs to release-notes branch by EOD.
marie: Also reminder: version bump PR is open — please approve. If any blockers, comment here otherwise we'll merge at cutoff +5m.
tomas: I pushed a tiny fix to hotfix branch, PTAL @ajay for CI run.
build-bot: CI run finished: 4821 status: failed (3 flaky tests). Failing suites: integration/auth, e2e/browser. Details: https://ci.redwood/4821/logs
ajay: Re-running the specific auth test in isolation now.
ajay: Isolated run passed twice locally. Might be infra-related. @ci-oncall can we pin a newer node image?
ci-oncall: I'll schedule a node image roll to stable-2026-02-12. ETA 30m.
lina: :thumbsup: I removed a sleep that should help timing; opening PR to release/v2.7.0-hotfix.
marie: If infra rollback or image change will take time, consider temporary reroute: update pipeline to skip e2e/browser for cut if failing more than 2x. We can document in release notes.
emily: If we skip, note in changelog: 'browser e2e flaky on mac; workaround applied' — please add one-liner.
ajay: Re-run auth test after lina's PR merged.
build-bot: Hotfix PR merged, triggering pipeline #4825.
build-bot: Pipeline #4825 status: success. Release branch health: green except e2e/browser flaky.
tomas: Good. I will queue a flaky test ticket and assign to QA to monitor browser e2e.
marie: OK team — plan: merge version bump at 09:00 PDT if no new fails. @ci-oncall keep us posted on node image. @emily collect final changelog bullets. If anything else, post here.
ci-oncall: Node image roll started.
emily: I'll consolidate changelog and open release-notes PR in ~25m.
marie: :partyparrot: Thanks all. If we get green by 08:50 PDT, proceed with cut. Otherwise, we'll pivot to canary and delay full cut by 2h.
